title: ynh ps --format json
description: Output of `ynh ps --format json` (also the `ynh_ps` MCP tool). Bare object holding the seat presence records `ynh run` wrote, each with its derived status, oldest first. Without --all only live and orphaned sessions are listed. Like paths and status it carries no capabilities envelope. `mode`, `state` and `status` are open sets: consumers must tolerate values they do not know.

vendor_pid.description: Vendor process id once it has started; omitted until then.

vendor_start.description: Vendor process start, an opaque per-OS number; ynh stop signals the vendor only while the process at vendor_pid started then. Omitted until the vendor has started.

start_time.description: Wrapper process start, an opaque per-OS number used to tell a live wrapper from a reused pid.

started_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC wall-clock start, for people.

accepts_tasks.description: True for an interactive session that can take a task delegated to its harness (it has the ynh-inbox MCP server and its allow rule).

owner_session.description: For a delegate, the session that started it; omitted otherwise.

address.description: The name the session answers to, `ynh:<session_id>`.

last_beat.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last heartbeat.

status.description: Derived: live, orphaned, dead or ended.

open_questions.description: Questions this session's delegates have asked it that nobody has answered yet, oldest delegation first; omitted when there are none. A delegate's question belongs to the newest live, non-delegate session of the parent harness in the folder the delegation ran in.

asked_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time the question was asked.

waiting_seconds.description: How long it has waited, when the listing was made.
